from.says: Where the holon was born from, as a path in the files it arrived from.

gives.says: For a program of one's own, the expression it gives, each argument it was given named as { arg: i }.

native.says: For one of glass's own, the name the engine runs it by.

says.says: What it gathers, in a sentence.

takes.says: What it is given, each in turn: a set, any number of sets, words, a store's key, or an axis to group by; nothing unless it says.

title.says: What the program is called, as it is offered to be called.

body.says: Something that gathers from the field, given what it takes: glass's own, run by the engine, or one's own, an expression over what it is given. An expression calls a program, and is called by what it gives; a program kept as a favorite is a way of looking one can return to.
body.title: Program
